_comment: The §10.7 proactive turn: the robot speaks and NOBODY SPOKE FIRST.
Note what is absent — there is no user_transcript event, and that absence is the fixture's
whole content. Every other session under assets/sessions/ replays a conversation someone
started; this one replays a conversation a clock started. Using two_turn here instead would
have the gate reading that fixture's own user turn and reporting it as proactive.
⚠️ IT CARRIES AUDIO, and that is the whole repair. The first version of this fixture had a
transcript and no audio chunk, on the reasoning that playback is M4's and M5's ground. That
decision hid a crash: AudioService mints a turn id only from its own VAD, so the first
assistant chunk on a proactive turn asserted on a None id and killed the pump. The gate went
green because no audio ever flowed. The thing excluded from the fixture was the thing that
